intro: One chicken kebab is about 550 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the bread, the oily chicken filling and the garlic or mayo sauce.
diet: Yes, a chicken kebab has fairly high protein plus some vegetables. But the kebab chicken is usually cooked with oil, and the sauce can add a lot of calories. Have one as lunch or dinner, not as a snack. Pick a sugar-free drink to keep total calories in check.
tips: Ask for less garlic sauce and more chilli sauce.
Ask for extra salad and vegetables inside.
Skip the extra cheese and fries.

swap.name: Grilled chicken wrap, no mayo
swap.why: Same idea but less sauce and oil, so you save about 200 kcal.

faq.q: Are kebab and shawarma the same?
faq.a: Quite similar. Both use meat roasted on a rotating spit. The spices and serving style differ by country.

faq.q: Is pasar malam kebab safe to eat?
faq.a: Choose a clean stall and make sure the meat is fully cooked. It should be hot and not pink in the middle.

faq.q: Can I eat a kebab for dinner?
faq.a: Yes. One kebab with plain water is enough as a meal for most people.
